source_semantics: platform_posted_net is observed finalized net credit added to the AdSense for YouTube balance, not estimated current-month video earnings or a gross figure before withholding and adjustments.
platform_issued is an actual issued balance payment, not an eligibility prediction; platform_bank_received is actually cleared cash, potentially in a later calendar month.

sponsor_cash_received, affiliate_cash_received, merch_cash_received and other_non_youtube_cash_received are outside-platform received transfers, not contracted but unpaid invoices and not native YouTube payments.
refunds_paid and cash expense fields are paid costs only and must not duplicate amounts already netted upstream.
hours include unsuccessful productions, publishing, marketing and administrative labor; cash movement per working hour is not wages, profit or a causal result.
payment_hold and source-defined account currency threshold determine only conditional standard issuance eligibility; account approval, policy review and settlement timing remain separate.
All monetary and hour values are mandatory explicit numbers; missing is never implicitly zero. Test fixtures are invented solely to verify arithmetic and are not observations.

YouTube Shopping affiliate commissions are credited and paid via AdSense for YouTube following merchant confirmation (typically 60–120 days after purchase). Include an actual finalized shopping-affiliate credit in platform_posted_net if it is part of the account posting, and later in bank_received exactly once. The affiliate_cash_received field is for independent external affiliate schemes, not duplicate Shopping commissions.
